# Group Input

Brings the host object's geometry into your node graph.

`lfs.group_input` · Input

## How to use

Connect Geometry to the first editing node.  
In a modifier stack you receive the previous modifier's result.  

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Incoming host geometry, or the previous modifier's result. Connect this to your first editing node. |
